annotations.title: Duration between two dates/times, calendar difference and business days

description: Duration between two dates/times, calendar difference and business days. Exact duration (seconds, minutes, hours, days), calendar difference in years/months/days, and the number of weekdays (Mon-Fri) between two dates, evaluated in a chosen time zone. Optionally adds a duration to a date. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
